name: Snow White ~The Veil of My Heart~
source:
A small town between the sea and the mountains. The last school year passes by and main hero has time before Christmas to settle his feelings.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一座位于大海和山脉之间的小镇。最后一个学年过去了，主角在圣诞节前有时间安顿自己的感情。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
